propositions: A container ticket with no declared file_impact falls back to whole-HEAD invalidation, causing any unrelated commit to invalidate the attestation and force re-review (over-invalidation).

Container plan-review scope should inherit the union of direct children's declared file_impact, but only when all non-closed children declare non-empty file_impact (poison rule: empty child impact prevents inheritance).

Direct children whose file_impact is edited after container attestation should invalidate the container via material fingerprint pin drift, while grandchild changes do not silently stale the container (dependency holds one level deep only).
When inheritance is effective, unrelated commits must not invalidate the container attestation, but commits to child-declared files must block the claim and name the drift.
Closed children should neither contribute files to the inherited union nor poison it, because their work is delivered and later churn belongs to other tickets (ADR 0024 completion floor).

P9 container DET-floor check must surface an advisory (non-blocking) naming non-closed children with empty file_impact when inheritance is poisoned, so authors understand why whole-HEAD fallback persists.
